svg.title: Two histories remain separate columns
svg.desc: Establish two full-height histories with a hard unbroken divider. Match their scale but keep headers, events and routes wholly inside their respective columns. Visual distinction: A docket slot beside a raised review desk and a closed stop arm. Review is a decision process; no approval is implied.
